card.name: Calls to action beginning with we or let
card.fires_on: The first word of a rallying sentence in opinion or speech-style writing, such as "We must", "We need", "Let us" or "it is time". It sits right after a sentence that states a problem or goal.

modes.label: Let us
modes.description: The word "let" opening an exhortation, as in "let us".
modes.example: We can all commit to adopting these habits and to do our part for our only home.<< Let>> us celebrate Earth

modes.label: We must / we need
modes.description: A sentence-initial "We" starting a call for collective action.
modes.example: Efforts to encourage innovation should stretch well beyond science and technology. Graduates in the fine arts, humanities and social sciences have roles to play.<< We>> need their creativity, ability to express important

modes.label: It is time
modes.description: The word "time" in "it is time" leading into a call for change.
modes.example: I believe that it’s<< time>> for a new type of standards. I

card.writes: It pushes the model to continue with "we" phrases of collective duty, such as we must, we need and let us, in Chinese as well.
card.plain: It marks the point in a persuasive text where the writer turns to what "we" must do.
